translations.web: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
translations.bsb: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
translations.kjv: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
translations.asv: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
